name: Choreo IR
install:
python3 -m pip install --user -e '.[dev]'
CHOREO_FETCH_NVCC=1 python3 -c "from choreoir.toolchain import ensure_nvcc; import sys; p=ensure_nvcc(); print(p or 'nvcc-missing'); sys.exit(0 if p else 1)"
python3 -c "from choreoir.toolchain import find_ccec; print(find_ccec() or 'ccec-missing')"
